CustomField.description: The agent payout that settled this line. A line with a payout has been paid out to the subagent; a line without one has not. Set by the Agents tab when a payout is recorded, and cleared again if that payout is voided.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: 이 라인을 정산한 지급 기록입니다. 값이 있으면 서브에이전트에게 지급 완료, 비어 있으면 미지급입니다.
CustomField.label: Payout
